change: After LiveKit confirms a remote screen-video subscription, the Web client reports the viewer lease and exact track to an authenticated Go endpoint. The server verifies both active leases in the same open VOICE channel and the owner's current LiveKit screen publication, keeps bounded ephemeral presence with heartbeat expiry, and sends the owner an empty private invalidation. The owner loads a no-store snapshot and marks matching room participants with an eye icon; a compact audience count appears with the screen participant strip.

qa_report_note: The local-feature harness preserves REVIEW_REQUIRED until a screenshot baseline is explicitly approved. Relevant changed-flow screenshots were reviewed and noted; no new baseline was approved just to change the automated report status.
limitation: The two-client media run uses the repository's synthetic canvas and quiet audio source on a local stack; it does not prove OS picker behavior, human attention, physical-device media quality, or hardware capacity. This change reports Web-client subscriptions; Flutter clients do not yet send viewer-presence heartbeats. A disconnected viewer expires after the 20-second heartbeat TTL.
